title: Growth & Partnerships Lead, FinTech SMBs & Marketplaces
description:
Position: Growth & Partnerships Lead, FinTech for US SMBs & Marketplaces
Location: New York
Lian Lian is seeking a dynamic Business Development Lead to drive growth across SMBs and US eCommerce marketplaces. You will identify Ideal Client Profiles, strategize product-market fit, and build local partnerships to accelerate merchant onboarding.
The ideal candidate has 6+ years in fintech/payments p...artnerships, a strong US SMB/eCommerce network, and a proven track record of sourcing and scaling partnerships. MBA preferred; cross-functional collaboration with Product and Sales is essential.
The Growth & Partnerships Lead, Fin Tech for US SMBs & Marketplaces role at Lian Lian is now open for applications in New York, NY, United States.
As a Growth & Partnerships Lead, Fin Tech for US SMBs & Marketplaces, you will play an important part at Lian Lian in New York, NY, United States.
We invite applications for the Growth & Partnerships Lead, Fin Tech for US SMBs & Marketplaces position located in New York, NY, United States.
